human_review_guidance: You are deciding on a brief about recorded evidence, not on a property's worth. Reject any brief that states or implies a valuation, a price forecast or a buy recommendation, however hedged. Approve only when every critical and high check passed and the prose matches the figures: the eligible count, the median, the exclusions and the limitations must all be reported together, because a median without its exclusions overstates the evidence. Where the case carries synthetic showcase data, the brief must say so. Use "correct" to send the Worker and Reviewer back once with a note, "partial" to accept only the steps that hold, and "reject" when the brief should not be used.
objective: Summarise the recorded sale observations saved in one market case, with the exclusions, source coverage and limitations that bound them. Do not estimate a property value, forecast a price or recommend whether to buy.
planner_guidance: Inspect the saved case first for its name, address, date window, status and filters, then calculate its deterministic sales summary. Plan only these two read-only steps. Never plan a write, and never plan a step that estimates value, forecasts a price or recommends a purchase.

reviewer_checks.description: The requested market case was inspected.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Check the market case identifier and run the brief again.

reviewer_checks.description: The deterministic sales summary was calculated.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Without the summary there is no evidence to brief; run it again.

reviewer_checks.description: The brief can name the case rather than an internal identifier.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Give the case a descriptive name before briefing it.

reviewer_checks.description: The case resolves to a property address the brief can refer to.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Re-select the property so the brief can name an address instead of a reference.

reviewer_checks.description: The property reference was checked against the Property data research area.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Do not brief a case whose property could not be verified; re-select the property and retry.

reviewer_checks.description: At least one sale observation is eligible under the case filters.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Widen the date window or lower the match tier; an empty brief states nothing.

reviewer_checks.description: The summary reports the limitations that bound its figures.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: The brief must carry the data service's limitations; do not accept a summary without them.

reviewer_checks.description: The eligible sales are attributed to at least one source release.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Import a published sales release before briefing the case.

reviewer_checks.description: The summary reports how many observations it excluded.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Read the exclusion counts beside the median; a median drawn from a narrow sample is weak.

reviewer_checks.description: The minimum match tier that filtered the evidence is recorded.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: State the match threshold in the brief so the reader can judge attribution.

reviewer_checks.description: A median recorded price could be calculated from the eligible sales.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Without a median, brief the transaction volume and exclusions and say the median is absent.
